text:
Alyssa: Heads-up — new model artifacts uploaded to intake bucket for LLamaX-13B-v1. Need to run acceptance gate before registry. Key checks: checksums, signature, tokenizer compatibility, license, basic evals. Assigning priority = medium. :clipboard:

acq-bot: automated upload notice:
  path: s3://redwood-models/incoming/llamax/13b/v1/
  files: model.bin (4.2G), tokenizer.json, tokenizer.model, manifest.yml, artifact.sig
  sha256:model.bin = 3f7e2a9b1e4c9b4d8a5f1c2e6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5

Miguel: grabbing checksum now. Also: who signed this? need signer key id and KMS envelope info. If it's external vendor, we need PGP/RSA pubkey on file. :mag:

Sophie: I see manifest.yml includes signer: vendor-acme, sig_algo: rsa-sha256, kms_wrapped:false. No KMS envelope present. Vendor provided pubkey URL in manifest. Quick verify steps I ran locally:
```
# download pubkey and verify
curl -sS https://vendor.example/pubkeys/acme.pub -o acme.pub
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify acme.pub -signature artifact.sig model.bin
```
Result: "Verified OK" for signature, signature timestamp 2026-11-01T15:03:21Z. :white_check_mark:

Jen: good. Next validate tokenizer compatibility with our tokenization registry. tokenizer.json shows "vocab_size":50265, "model_max_length":2048, "tokenizer_type":"byte-level-bpe" and "special_tokens":{...}. Quick check: our embedding/serving infra expects either 50257 or a mapped tokenizer. Miguel — any concerns about vocab mismatch for prefix caching?

Miguel: vocab delta small but we need remapping test. If token ids shift, prefix-cache will be invalid for any precomputed caches. Plan: run token-sanity tool against our registry mapping: 
```
python tools/token_sanity.py --incoming tokenizer.json --canonical-id bpe-50257
```
If mapping diff > 2% we flag for forced cache-warmup.

Chris: Also add license check — manifest says license: "academic-research-only". That blocks hosted usage. We should gate: intake -> "accepted:internal-only" unless legal signs off. Tag on registry: intake:accepted-internal.

Sophie: ran basic evals (small suite):
- perplexity on wiki-dev (20k tokens): baseline (our current prod 13B) = 6.12
- this model (fp16) = 6.08
- this model (int8 quant attempt quickrun) = 6.35
- instruction-following micro eval (500 prompts): helpfulness 0.88 -> quantized 0.86
Notes: fp16 looks fine; int8 shows modest regressions. We should plan quantization experiments with QAT or qlora + NLPAug tuning.

Alyssa: good catch on license. For acceptance gate checklist, I'm proposing we require (1) signature verified, (2) checksum match, (3) tokenizer sanity pass or mapping strategy, (4) license classification, (5) smoke evals within regression thresholds, (6) manifest metadata complete. If any fail -> tag intake:needs-action.

Miguel: adding technical detail for provenance ledger entry. Need the following lines for registry manifest append:
```
artifact_id: llimax-13b-v1
origin: vendor-acme
s3_path: s3://redwood-models/incoming/llamax/13b/v1/
sha256: 3f7e2a9b1e4c9b4d8a5f1c2e6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5
signature_algo: rsa-sha256
signature_key_id: acme-20261101
license: academic-research-only
intake_status: pending-eval
```
No sensitive fields (no KMS data).

Jen: decision rules for prioritization: if evals show regression > 5% on instruction helpfulness OR perplexity delta > 0.3 -> deprioritize and only accept for offline experiments. Otherwise, if fp16 baseline is equal/better and license allows, mark as "candidate-for-serving" and create canary job.

Chris: quantify the regression policy into a literal label so CI can auto-tag: create label "intake:regression-major" when either condition met. Otherwise "intake:passed-smoke". I'll add rule in registry ingestion lambda.

Alyssa: next steps I'll do: 1) update registry manifest with Miguel's lines, 2) Sophie will run tokenizer mapping test and full eval sweep, 3) Jen to confirm legal on license and product gating, 4) Chris to add tagging rule in ingestion. Aim to complete by EOD tomorrow. Anyone object? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Miguel: fine. I'll also spin up a short quantization matrix for int8 vs q4_0 on a subset and post results. Expect first numbers in ~6 hours.

Sophie: starting token sanity now, posting diff summary when done.

acq-bot: registry note queued — new intake created (id: intake-20261101-013). Use /intake status intake-20261101-013 to query.

Alyssa: perfect — thanks all. I'll follow up with a short playbook snippet for the acceptance gate so we don't reinvent this per intake. :memo:
